note: Named, finite baseline debt for the changed-scope blocking stage of the ADR 0019 rollout. Anything not listed here blocks. An entry that is no longer a gap also fails validation, so this file cannot rot. Full release blocking turns on when `entries` is empty. These are not waivers: nobody has accepted them, and no expiry has been agreed.

entries.detail: There is no single 'general control command' budget to measure. The relay has per-operation budgets (attach 15 s, list 15 s, stop 20 s) and none of them is the 10 s the PRD names.
entries.resolution: Restate the criterion per operation, or introduce the single budget it assumes.

entries.detail: PRD says a 30 s file-read budget; `file_read_timeout_seconds` is 15. A test either way would record one of the two as the requirement.
entries.resolution: Decide which number is right and change the other to match.

entries.detail: PRD states a 2-10 MB ring buffer. The daemon configures a 5000-line tmux scrollback and the browser a 10000-line one; lines are not bytes, so the criterion has no measurable form today.
entries.resolution: Restate the scrollback guarantee in the units the implementation can hold to.
